adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transactional consistency issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff, line 92-109 shows `prisma.booking.update()` that adds guests to the database, and line 165 shows `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` which can fail. If the calendar update fails after the database write succeeds, the guests are persisted in the database but the caller receives an error. A retry would fail because the guests are already present (filtered out by uniqueGuests check at line 73-76). This is a real atomicity/consistency bug where partial state can occur.
